cja_panel.what: Court-approved private attorneys appointed on a rotating basis for people who cannot afford counsel (18 U.S.C. § 3006A). Four panels: Tier One Trial, Tier Two Trial, Appellate, and Eureka. Venues: San Jose (Monterey, San Benito, Santa Clara, Santa Cruz counties); San Francisco/Oakland (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Sonoma). See General Order 2, Section XI.
